6_verdict.mechanism: R13b exempts only byte-identical ==0.05 from amount/split/near; sequence (+/-10% tol, so 0.05<->0.055 passes), cadence burst and drip have NO minimum exemption; 3-decimal amounts 0.051-0.061 count as 'odd' fingerprints reaching across all 66 hours; the h34-35 rush (701+552 first deposits, 621+378 at 0.05, volume 53->826 ETH) produced consecutive-index runs at 0.05 that sequence welded; near/sequence bridged 0.05 to 0.051-0.055; exact_odd chains bridged hours.
6_verdict.recommended_rule: generalize R13b from amount==min to amount<=1.25*min (or: <=3-decimal amounts below 0.1 ETH are human-typed 'min+dust') for sequence, drip, exact_odd, near, round_wave, split; keep burst (Disperse batch survives as 6 per-block clusters with cadence+funding+gas). Variant B: cluster 7 -> 60 flagged (37 Disperse farm, 7 h15 single-funder batch, 16 in three h34-35 exchange-hub pieces), population 11573 -> 10040, labeled farms 134/160 (loses 7 labeled 0.05 members that live in other drip/peel clusters), controls 30 -> 25.
